test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 7 Oct 2021 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
P, Q, R, S, T, U and V are standing in a queue.

i. T is just behind P.

ii. V is just in front of Q, who is not the last person.

iii. S is between P and R.

iv. There is one person between T and Q.

Who is the last person in the queue?
solution: **People: **P, Q, R, S, T, U and V. i. T is just behind P. ii. V is just in front of Q, who is not the last person. iv. There is one person between T and Q.
